EC2: - patients on immunosuppressive drugs, intake of prednisolone ([OR]or equivalent) >10 mg for at least 3 weeks or a diagnosis of human immunodeficiency virus syndrome
EC3: - intake antifungal azoles for >3 weeks in the preceding six months
EC4: - subjects with active pulmonary infection due to mycobacterium tuberculosis [OR] or mycobacteria other than tuberculosis (MOTT)
EC5: - subjects with others forms of pulmonary aspergillosis (allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis, chronic necrotizing aspergillosis [OR] and angio-invasive aspergillosis)
